policyEngines.name: reInventDemoPolicyEngine
policyEngines.description: Scopes the storyblokAgentGateway execution role to exactly the Storyblok tool/operation combinations the productBrief-to-storyblokPage skill uses -- nothing else.

policies.name: allowDiscoveryTools
policies.description: search and describe are metadata-only lookups against the cached Storyblok OpenAPI catalog -- they never touch real space data, so no operation-level restriction is needed.

policies.name: allowProductPageReadonlyOperations
policies.description: Exactly the execute_readonly operations the productBrief-to-storyblokPage skill uses: checking for an existing page, fetching a story fresh before update, finding real assets, and fetching the live productPage component whitelist.

policies.name: allowProductPageMutatingOperations
policies.description: Exactly the execute_mutating operations the productBrief-to-storyblokPage skill uses: create/update the story, and move it into the Reviewing workflow stage.

policies.name: denyDestructiveAndUploadTools
policies.description: Defense in depth: the skill never publishes, deletes, or uploads assets, so these are explicitly forbidden rather than just left unpermitted -- this stays effective even if a future policy accidentally grants them.
